name: tech.recoup-iq/uk-company-facts
title: TrustCheck by RecoupIQ: UK Company Facts
description: Dated UK company facts from public records, with a signed credential check. Free tools need no key.

tools.name: company_status
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns dated basic facts for one UK company from official records: status, age, late filings, insolvency notice, and whether a director ban in force is on record. Company-level facts only. Indicators only, not advice. For a risk score and joined register checks, use risk_assess with an API key. Returns JSON with fields companyNumber, companyName, status, incorporatedOn, accountsOverdue, confirmationStatementOverdue, insolvencyNoticeOnRecord, latestInsolvencyNotice, petitionOnRecord, directorBanInForceOnRecord, recordsCheckedOn, recordDate, validUntil, source, liveUrl. When no record exists it returns companyNumber, found false and notice. The optional fields input keeps only the named fields. Each answer states its record date and its source.

companyNumber.description: UK Companies House registration number, 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in the result, for example ["companyNumber","status"]. Unknown names are ignored. companyNumber is always kept.

tools.name: company_status_batch
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns the company_status answer for 1 to 25 UK companies in one call. Each number counts as one call against the free hourly limit. Returns JSON with one field, results: an array in the order of the input, where each item is the company_status object, or an object with companyNumber and error for an invalid number. Company-level facts only. Indicators only, not advice.

company_numbers.description: UK Companies House registration numbers. 1 to 25 items.

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in each result, for example ["companyNumber","status"]. Unknown names are ignored. companyNumber, found and notice are always kept when present.

tools.name: check_company_seal
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns the current signed credential summary for one UK company: record date, confirmed-through date, valid-until time, status facts, and evidence hash. Pass an optional evidenceHash to learn if a credential you hold is CURRENT, SUPERSEDED, or EXPIRED. Returns the URLs to verify the signature. The credential is a dated public record snapshot. It is not advice. Returns JSON with fields companyNumber, companyName, credentialId, recordDate, confirmedThrough, validUntil, issuedAt, expired, statusFacts, evidenceHash, evidenceHashCheck, credentialUrl, verifyUrl, publicKeyUrl, source. Each answer states its record date and its source.

companyNumber.description: UK Companies House registration number, 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

evidenceHash.description: Optional. The 64-character evidence hash of a credential you hold.

tools.name: sector_payment_days
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns the median days to pay for one UK sector (SIC division), across companies, with the average share of payments beyond 60 days across companies, the report count, the period covered and the as-of date. Coverage is large companies that must report under the UK payment practices rules. It is not all companies. Returns value null with a reason when a sector has fewer than 30 companies or no match. Each answer states its date and its source. Returns JSON with fields value, unit, pct_beyond_60, sic_division, sector_label, n_reports, n_companies, period_covered, as_of, source, coverage_note, caveat, url, or value and reason. Indicator to verify, not advice.

sic_division.description: Optional. UK SIC 2007 division, 2 digits. For example 10 for food manufacturing.

sector.description: Optional. A word from the sector name. For example wholesale. Use sic_division when a word matches several sectors.

tools.name: sector_staff_change
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns, for one UK sector (SIC division), the share of paired companies whose reported staff number rose, fell or stayed the same between two filings about one year apart, with the net staff change, the median change, the number of paired companies, both periods and the as-of date. Coverage is companies that file staff numbers in both years. Micro and small companies often do not, so it is not all companies. Flat includes companies that report the same number every year, including 0 or 1 staff. Returns value null with a reason when a sector has fewer than 30 paired companies or no match. Each answer states its date and its source. Returns JSON with fields value, unit, pct_grew, pct_shrank, pct_flat, pct_flat_zero_or_one, n_flat_zero_or_one, net_change_staff, median_change_staff, sic_division, sector_label, n, n_paired, period, period_before, as_of, source, coverage_note, caveat, url, or value and reason. Counts and shares only. Indicator to verify, not advice.

sic_division.description: Optional. UK SIC 2007 division, 2 digits. For example 41 for construction of buildings.

sector.description: Optional. A word from the sector name. For example wholesale. Use sic_division when a word matches several sectors.

tools.name: company_counts
tools.description: Free, no API key. Returns a count of UK companies. Use measure new_companies for companies formed in one month, by postcode area (for example LS) and SIC division. The same month a year earlier is not given, because closed companies are missing from older months. Use measure live_companies for live companies by postcode district (for example LS1) and SIC division. Live means status Active, including the status "Active - Proposal to Strike off". The postcode is the registered office, not the trading site. London and virtual offices raise some counts. New company counts include only companies still on the register snapshot, so older months read low. Returns value null with a reason when a group has fewer than 10 companies. Some larger groups are also null, so a hidden group cannot be worked out from totals. Counts only, no advice. Returns JSON with fields measure, value, n, unit, postcode_area or postcode_district, sic_division, sector_label, period, as_of, register_snapshot_date, source, coverage_note, url, or value and reason.

measure.description: new_companies counts companies formed in a month. live_companies counts live companies.

postcode_area.description: Optional, for new_companies. The letters at the start of the registered office postcode, for example LS. Leave out for all of the UK.

postcode_district.description: Optional, for live_companies. The part of the registered office postcode before the space, for example LS1. Leave out for all of the UK.

sic_division.description: Optional. UK SIC 2007 division, 2 digits. For example 41 for construction of buildings. Leave out for all sectors.

month.description: Optional, for new_companies. The month, YYYY-MM, one of the last 12 full months. Default is the latest full month.

tools.name: risk_assess
tools.description: Returns a 0 to 100 forensic risk score, risk band, and source-backed governance, premises, licence-gap, solvency, and filing indicators for a UK company. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields company_number, company_name, timestamp, risk_bands, signals, priced_risk, evidence, audit_trail_id, model_version, meta, source, liveUrl, recordDate, validUntil. Each answer states its record date and its source.

companyNumber.description: UK Companies House registration number, 8 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

tools.name: entity_resolve
tools.description: Returns ranked UK Companies House registration numbers for a fuzzy company name with confidence scores and company status flags. Pass an optional UK postcode to improve match precision. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields query, postcode_hint, total_results, candidates, meta. Each candidate has company_number, company_name, company_status, confidence and flags.

query.description: Company name as shown on an invoice, contract, or order.

postcodeHint.description: Optional UK postcode hint to narrow candidate matches.

tools.name: cross_border_assess
tools.description: Bundled assessment for international enterprise teams checking UK counterparties. Returns source-backed company evidence, uncertainty notes, verification questions, and jurisdiction context. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields company_number, company_name, timestamp, caller_action, risk_bands, signals, priced_risk, evidence, audit_trail_id, regime_context, model_version, meta, source, liveUrl, recordDate, validUntil. Each answer states its record date and its source.

callerJurisdiction.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the caller home jurisdiction (for example US, DE, FR).

tools.name: watch_company
tools.description: Subscribes a registered tenant webhook or email address to alerts when a UK company files an insolvency notice, faces strike-off, or records director disqualifications. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields status, message and data. The data field holds subscriptionId, companyNumber and subscribed_events.

tools.name: request_corporate_eval
tools.description: Public onboarding tool (no API key required). Emails a free UK company API key (1,000 checks each calendar month) to a corporate work address (not a personal webmail address) and returns the key details. Returns JSON with fields status, maskedEmail, allowanceCalls, expiresInDays, financeApprovalUrl, slackMessageForFinance.

companyName.description: Legal or trading name of your organisation.

workEmail.description: Corporate work email address (personal webmail domains are rejected).

intendedUse.description: Optional summary of intended integration or data use.
